directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: Dusty, take a look at this box. Can you open it?
entries.JA_current: Dusty, take a look at this box. Can you open it?
entries.JA_new: ダスティ、この箱を見てくれ。開けられるか？

entries.EN: Well, let me see... Listen, where did you find it?
entries.JA_current: Well, let me see... Listen, where did you find it?
entries.JA_new: どれどれ……ところで、どこで見つけた？

entries.EN: Found it in a mercenary camp. So, can you crack it?
entries.JA_current: Found it in a mercenary camp. So, can you crack it?
entries.JA_new: マーセナリーズのキャンプだ。開けられそうか？

entries.EN: No, Marked One, I won't touch it. Not because I can't open this lock, but because it's better that neither you nor I get involved with these mercenaries and do not interfere in their affairs. Trust me, don't go poking around merc business, you'll live considerably longer.
entries.JA_current: No, Marked One, I won't touch it. Not because I can't open this lock, but because it's better that neither you nor I get involved with these mercenaries and do not interfere in their affairs. Trust me, don't go poking around merc business, you'll live considerably longer.
entries.JA_new: いや、マークド・ワン。俺は手を出さない。鍵を開けられないからじゃない。俺もあんたもマーセナリーズに関わらず、連中の仕事に口を出さない方がいいんだ。信じろ。連中の揉め事に首を突っ込まなければ、ずっと長生きできる。

entries.EN: Come on, what could possibly be so bad inside there? Mercs won't find out who took the box.
entries.JA_current: Come on, what could possibly be so bad inside there? Mercs won't find out who took the box.
entries.JA_new: いいじゃないか、中に何があるっていうんだ？誰が箱を持っていったか、マーセナリーズには分からないさ。

entries.EN: If what I know about those guys is true, then they most certainly will find out. They definitely know already that their squad was hit and the box was taken, how long until they track it here and figure we peeked inside? If we were to see what is inside, that'll be a kill on sight order for the both of us. On the other hand, if they know that we didn't open it, they'll spare us but they'll still break your fingers for taking the box in the first place. You know the legend of Pandora's Box? Well, listen to me: take this container back to where you found it, maybe you'll actually get to wake up and not get wasted in your sleep.
entries.JA_current: If what I know about those guys is true, then they most certainly will find out. They definitely know already that their squad was hit and the box was taken, how long until they track it here and figure we peeked inside? If we were to see what is inside, that'll be a kill on sight order for the both of us. On the other hand, if they know that we didn't open it, they'll spare us but they'll still break your fingers for taking the box in the first place. You know the legend of Pandora's Box? Well, listen to me: take this container back to where you found it, maybe you'll actually get to wake up and not get wasted in your sleep.
entries.JA_new: 俺の知る限り、連中は必ず突き止める。部隊が襲われて箱を奪われたことは、もう知られてるはずだ。ここまで追ってきて、俺たちが中を覗いたと分かるまで、どれくらいかかる？中を見たら、二人とも見つけ次第殺される。開けてないと分かれば、見逃してはくれるだろうが、そもそも箱を盗んだ指をへし折られるだろうな。パンドラの箱の話を知ってるか？いいから聞け。箱は見つけた場所へ戻せ。そうすれば、朝目を覚ませるかもしれない。寝てる間に殺されずにな。

entries.EN: Still, I want to know what's inside. Don't care how the mercs feel about it.
entries.JA_current: Still, I want to know what's inside. Don't care how the mercs feel about it.
entries.JA_new: それでも中身が知りたい。マーセナリーズがどう思おうと関係ない。

entries.EN: Well, if you're so eager to get tortured to death, then go to Freedom's base up in the army warehouses, find a stalker named Shurup and ask him to crack it. He's a former techie, so he might be able to figure it out, but it's a pass for me, sorry.
entries.JA_current: Well, if you're so eager to get tortured to death, then go to Freedom's base up in the army warehouses, find a stalker named Shurup and ask him to crack it. He's a former techie, so he might be able to figure it out, but it's a pass for me, sorry.
entries.JA_new: そこまで拷問死したいなら、軍事倉庫にあるフリーダムの基地へ行け。シュルプってストーカーを探して、開けてもらえ。元技術屋だから何とかしてくれるかもしれない。俺は遠慮するよ。
